label.zh: 按三次回答的倾向二选一
label.en: One of two, by the leaning of the three answers

note.zh: 7110 结束一天后：若满足超验政体条件则 7120，否则若满足具身条件则 7121；两者都不满足则没有结果窗口。
note.en: One day after 7110: 7120 if eligible for the transcendent government, else 7121 if eligible for the corporeal one; if neither, no result window.

notes.zh: “歌”的名称、描述与两个回答都由脚本本地化按随机选中的歌生成；每个回答朝“超验”或“具身”高级政体推进一步。
notes.en: The song name, description and both answers are scripted localisation for a randomly selected song; each answer moves one step towards the transcendent or the corporeal advanced government.

scope.zh: 触发条件、三首歌的顺序与两种政体结果均已核对；具体歌曲文本来自脚本本地化，未逐首列出。
scope.en: Trigger, the order of the three songs and both government results were checked; the individual song texts come from scripted localisation and are not listed one by one.

uncertain: The per-delve probability value:shroud_song_roll and the eligibility triggers is_eligible_for_advanced_government were not expanded; the extractor shows the songs as [GetRolledShroudSong…] placeholders.
